title.zh: 所立者与依存的计数规律：每个选择之下，所立者的计数规律就是活动的计数规律；被围住时平衡与耗散单独为所立者定下变化界，不需要体现，所以从某步起被围住时与有限世界中，所立者的计数规律是活动的计数规律，只是在平衡与耗散起约束之处不需要体现；前提不给依存的计数加任何规律
title.en: The laws of counting what stands and what depends: under each selection the laws of counting what stands are those of counting what is active; under enclosure balance and dissipation alone bound the change of what stands, with no embodiment, so with enclosure from some step on and in finite worlds the laws of counting what stands are those of counting what is active with embodiment dropped where balance and dissipation bind; the premises add nothing to the law of counting dependences

claim.zh: 读于水平（Web.StandingCensus）：所立者的普查在每一步不重复地列出立着的关系项；其计数是每步立着的数目，以及跨步不再立着与开始立着（开始作为条件而在）的数目（World.StandsObey）。关系项都体现时，所立者就是活跃者：所立者的普查就是活动的普查，反之亦然，计数相同，所以两者的计数满足同样的性质（World.Embodied.standsObey_iff）。不选体现时，由源供给的队列满足其余全部前提，不论计数：它是被驱动的队列，驱动者是一个地关系项，始终活跃而立在零，成员恰在队中时立着而从不活跃（World.sourcedQueue、World.sourcedQueue_holds、World.sourcedQueue_meets）；它平衡，只有源给予与取用，而源活跃，源与每个地关系项各交换一个单位，所以没有家族跨过任何一步封闭，耗散成立；它的所立者的普查计到队列所计的（World.sourcedQueue_standing、World.sourcedQueue_counts）。所以在 256 个选择的每一个之下，所立者的计数规律就是活动的计数规律（World.standing_counting_under、World.standing_iff_counting）：计数表，以及恰在选择约束计数时，没有关系项立着的一步上没有关系项开始立着（World.standing_binds_iff）。被围住为所立者定下界，不需要关于活动的前提：流平衡且耗散、从第 T 步起每步被围住时，所立者的任何普查自 T 起的变化不多于第 T 步所立者的总水平（World.enclosure_bounds_standing；立着的关系项至少立着一，Web.StandingCensus.length_le_stock），被围住而没有关系项立着的一步上没有关系项开始立着（World.enclosed_binds_standing）。选择选中平衡与耗散时，称它为所立者定下界（World.BoundsStanding）。所以从某步起每步被围住时，对计数的一个性质，在满足选择的每个这样的世界的所立者普查中成立，恰当它对每个这样的计数表成立：选择约束计数时，没有关系项立着的一步上没有关系项开始立着；选择为所立者定下界时，从某步 T 起变化在一个界之内，此后没有关系项立着的一步上没有关系项开始立着（World.enclosed_standing_counting_under）；那里变化界恰在选中平衡与耗散时是规律（World.enclosed_standing_bound_iff），而对活动还需要体现（World.enclosed_change_bound_iff）。选中平衡而不选体现时，见证是等待的队列：闭合的队列，其下一个加入者在开始立着之前就活跃，所以队首每步都活跃，队空时也是（EnclosedQueue.waiting、World.waitingQueue、World.waitingQueue_holds、World.waitingQueue_meets）；在第 0 步闭合时它每步被围住，满足除耗散与体现外的全部前提；在第 T 步闭合、从 T 起在变化界之内且此后没有成员加入空队时，满足除体现外的全部前提（World.closingQueue_dissipative）。有限世界的每一步都被围住，所以在每个选择之下，有限世界中所立者的计数规律是每步至多有某数立着的计数表，选择约束计数或为所立者定下界时再加没有关系项立着的一步上没有关系项开始立着，为所立者定下界时再加从第 0 步起的变化界（World.finite_standing_counting_under、World.finite_standing_binds_iff、World.finite_standing_bound_iff）；新的见证是每个位置始终活跃、被占时立着的环，满足除耗散与体现外的全部前提（World.activeRing、World.activeRing_holds）。读于依存（Web.DependenceCensus）：要求可判定时，前提不给依存的计数加任何规律：在每个选择之下，在每个世界中（World.dependence_counting）、从某步起每步被围住时（World.enclosed_dependence_counting），以及每步至多有某数依存时在有限世界中（World.finite_dependence_counting），对计数的一个性质在依存的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个计数表成立；有限世界中依存是关系项的对，至多是其数目的平方（pairs、mem_pairs）。队列的成员或环的位置在队中时依存于一个共同的条件，各需它的一个单位，它立在一、始终活跃，每个依存都被满足，没有什么流动，不论计数都满足全部八个前提（World.still_premised、World.dependingQueue_premised、World.dependingRing_premised）。不用伦理前提，不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Read of standing (Web.StandingCensus): a census of what stands lists at each step, once each, the relata standing there; its counts are how many stand at each step and how many cease to stand and come to stand across it (World.StandsObey). Where every relatum is embodied, what stands is what is active: a census of what stands is a census of activity and conversely, with the same counts, so the two obey the same properties (World.Embodied.standsObey_iff). Where embodiment is not selected, a queue fed from a source meets every other premise whatever its counts: the driven queue, its driver, a ground relatum, active throughout and standing at nothing, its members standing while in the queue and never active (World.sourcedQueue, World.sourcedQueue_holds, World.sourcedQueue_meets); it balances, only the source gives and takes, and the source is active, and since the source exchanges a unit each way with every ground relatum no family is closed across any step, so it dissipates; its census of what stands counts what the queue counts (World.sourcedQueue_standing, World.sourcedQueue_counts). So under each of the 256 selections the laws of counting what stands are those of counting what is active (World.standing_counting_under, World.standing_iff_counting): the tally and, exactly where the selection binds counting, nothing coming to stand across a step at which nothing stands (World.standing_binds_iff). Enclosure bounds what stands with no premise on activity: under a balanced, dissipative flow with every step from T on enclosed, the change from T of any census of what stands stays within the total standing at T (World.enclosure_bounds_standing; each relatum standing stands at one or more, Web.StandingCensus.length_le_stock), and nothing comes to stand across an enclosed step at which nothing stands (World.enclosed_binds_standing). A selection bounds what stands where it selects balance and dissipation (World.BoundsStanding). So with every step from some step on enclosed, a property of the counts holds of every census of what stands in every such world meeting a selection exactly when it holds of every tally in which, where the selection binds counting, nothing comes to stand across a step at which nothing stands, and, where it bounds what stands, from some step T on change stays within a bound and nothing comes to stand across a step at which nothing stands (World.enclosed_standing_counting_under); a change bound is a law there exactly where balance and dissipation are selected (World.enclosed_standing_bound_iff), while for activity embodiment is needed as well (World.enclosed_change_bound_iff). Where balance is selected without embodiment the witnesses are waiting queues: closing queues whose next to join is active before it comes to stand, so that the front is active at every step, even with the queue empty (EnclosedQueue.waiting, World.waitingQueue, World.waitingQueue_holds, World.waitingQueue_meets); closing at the first step a waiting queue is enclosed at every step and meets every premise but dissipation and embodiment; closing at T, with a change bound from T and nothing joining an empty queue from then on, every premise but embodiment (World.closingQueue_dissipative). Every step of a finite world is enclosed, so under each selection the laws of counting what stands in finite worlds are those of a tally with at most some number standing at each step, with nothing coming to stand across a step at which nothing stands where the selection binds counting or bounds what stands, and a change bound from the first step where it bounds what stands (World.finite_standing_counting_under, World.finite_standing_binds_iff, World.finite_standing_bound_iff); the new witness is a ring each of whose places is active throughout and stands while held, meeting every premise but dissipation and embodiment (World.activeRing, World.activeRing_holds). Read of dependence (Web.DependenceCensus): with requiring decided, the premises add nothing to the law of counting dependences: under each selection, in every world (World.dependence_counting), with every step from some step on enclosed (World.enclosed_dependence_counting) and, with at most some number holding at each step, in finite worlds (World.finite_dependence_counting), a property of the counts of a census of dependences holds exactly when it holds of every tally; in a finite world dependences are pairs of relata, at most the square of their number (pairs, mem_pairs). Members of a queue, or places of a ring, depending on a common condition while in it, each needing a unit of it, which stands at one and is active throughout, every dependence met, with nothing flowing, meet all eight premises whatever the counts (World.still_premised, World.dependingQueue_premised, World.dependingRing_premised). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 列出与可判定：同 whole-law-of-counting；读于水平时水平为正可判定（自然数的比较），读于依存时要求可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。
hypotheses.en: Listing and decidability: as in whole-law-of-counting; read of standing, a positive level is decided (a comparison of natural numbers), read of dependence, requiring is decided. It is a logical commitment of the representation.

hypotheses.zh: 逐点（Pointwise）：同 whole-law-of-counting，代替函数外延性，是定理的假设。
hypotheses.en: Pointwise: as in whole-law-of-counting, in place of function extensionality, a hypothesis of the theorems.

hypotheses.zh: 被围住与有限：同 counting-under-enclosure，是世界的条件，作为定理的假设陈述，不是公理。
hypotheses.en: Enclosure and finiteness: as in counting-under-enclosure, conditions on worlds stated as hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

correspondence.zh: 活动的计数规律（whole-law-of-counting、counting-under-enclosure）读的是什么活跃；本结果读同一个展开中什么立着、什么依存。不被围住时，所立者与活跃者服从相同的计数规律：体现使两者相同，不选体现时两者都只受计数表约束。被围住时两者分开：流所取用与给予的是水平，所以平衡与耗散单独就为所立者定下变化界，体现所做的是把这个界从所立者带到活跃者。依存的计数不受前提约束，因为前提只在依存与活动、水平与世系一起时约束它：活动需要支持只要求活跃者所依存的支持它，有界传递只要求后代开始立着时所依存的，其亲代也依存，所需在一个界之内。作者的读法（AI 论证）：被围住的展开所耗去的是立着的东西，活动只在体现时随之受约束；这是第一部分不加公理的计数规律在三个读法上的完整陈述，其中什么起约束（所选前提都起约束时）只对活动陈述。它不评价立起、不再立着、形成或消解。
correspondence.en: The laws of counting activity (whole-law-of-counting, counting-under-enclosure) read what is active; this result reads what stands and what depends in the same unfolding. Where nothing is enclosed what stands and what is active obey the same laws of counting: embodiment makes them one, and without it both are bound by the tally alone. Under enclosure they part: what the flow takes and gives is standing, so balance and dissipation alone bound the change of what stands, and what embodiment does is carry that bound from what stands to what is active. The counts of dependence are not bound by the premises, since the premises bear on dependence only together with activity, standing and descent: activity needing support asks only that what an active relatum depends on supports it, and bounded transmission only that what a descendant depends on as it comes to stand its parent depended on, within a bound. The author's reading (AI argument): what an enclosed unfolding spends is what stands, activity being bound with it only where embodied; this completes the statement of Part I's laws of counting, with no axiom, in the three readings, where binding (each selected premise binding) is stated for activity only. It does not evaluate coming to stand, ceasing to stand, forming or dissolving.

detail.zh: 复用计数表与队列（Tally、Listed.tally、Queue.holds、Queue.line、Queue.listed、Queue.counts）、逐点、World.CountsObey、World.counting_under 与 World.counting_binds_iff、开放与被驱动的队列（World.openQueue_census、World.openQueue_counts、World.drivenQueue_holds、OpenQueue.driven）。
detail.en: Reuses tallies and queues (Tally, Listed.tally, Queue.holds, Queue.line, Queue.listed, Queue.counts), Pointwise, World.CountsObey, World.counting_under and World.counting_binds_iff, and the open and driven queues (World.openQueue_census, World.openQueue_counts, World.drivenQueue_holds, OpenQueue.driven).

output.zh: 每个选择之下活动的计数规律是计数表，约束计数时再加没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起。
output.en: Under each selection the laws of counting activity are the tally, and where it binds counting, nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active.

input.zh: 体现时所立者就是活跃者，所以所立者的计数规律相同；不选体现时由源供给的队列实现每个计数表。
input.en: With embodiment what stands is what is active, so the laws of counting what stands are the same; without it a queue fed from a source counts every tally.

detail.zh: 复用被围住时与有限世界中每个选择之下的规律（World.enclosed_counting_under、World.enclosed_change_bound_iff、World.finite_counting_under）、闭合的队列（EnclosedQueue.closing、World.closingQueue_balanced、World.closingQueue_enclosed、World.closingQueue_dissipative）、环（Ring.census、Ring.counts、World.embodiedRing_meets）与有限的队列（World.finiteQueue_premised、World.finiteQueue_census、World.finiteQueue_counts）。
detail.en: Reuses the laws under each selection with enclosure and in finite worlds (World.enclosed_counting_under, World.enclosed_change_bound_iff, World.finite_counting_under), the closing queue (EnclosedQueue.closing, World.closingQueue_balanced, World.closingQueue_enclosed, World.closingQueue_dissipative), rings (Ring.census, Ring.counts, World.embodiedRing_meets) and the finite queue (World.finiteQueue_premised, World.finiteQueue_census, World.finiteQueue_counts).

output.zh: 被围住时与有限世界中，每个选择之下活动的计数规律；选中平衡、体现与耗散时再加变化界。
output.en: The laws of counting activity under each selection with enclosure and in finite worlds; a change bound where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected.

input.zh: 所立者的规律在选中平衡与耗散时就加变化界，不需要体现。
input.en: The laws of what stands add the change bound where balance and dissipation are selected, with no embodiment.

conditions.zh: 列出；可判定；逐点；被围住或有限。
conditions.en: Listing; decidability; pointwise; enclosure or finiteness.

detail.zh: 复用所立者的普查（Web.StandingCensus、World.standingCensus）、被围住的步上所立者的总水平不升而任何水平变化都使它下降（Flow.standing_never_rises、Flow.change_lowers）与被围住的步不是不围住所立者（Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not）。
detail.en: Reuses the census of what stands (Web.StandingCensus, World.standingCensus), that across an enclosed step the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it (Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.change_lowers), and that an enclosed step is not refutably enclosed around what stands (Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not).

output.zh: 平衡与耗散之下，围住所立者的步上总水平不升，任何水平变化都使它下降。
output.en: Under balance and dissipation, across a step enclosed around what stands, the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it.

input.zh: 被围住时所立者的变化不多于所立者的总水平，不需要关于活动的前提。
input.en: Under enclosure the change of what stands stays within the total standing, with no premise on activity.

conditions.zh: 所立者的普查；平衡；耗散；被围住。
conditions.en: A census of what stands; balance; dissipation; enclosure.

detail.zh: 复用八个前提与其选择（World.Premised.of、World.Premised.meets、World.Meets）、没有什么流动时四个关于流的前提空成立（World.still_vacuous）与有限世界每步被围住（World.Finite.enclosed）。
detail.en: Reuses the eight premises and their selections (World.Premised.of, World.Premised.meets, World.Meets), that the four premises about the flow hold vacuously where nothing flows (World.still_vacuous), and that every step of a finite world is enclosed (World.Finite.enclosed).

output.zh: 八个前提与其选择；有限世界每步被围住。
output.en: The eight premises and their selections; every step of a finite world enclosed.

input.zh: 依存的队列与环满足全部八个前提。
input.en: The depending queue and ring meet all eight premises.

detail.zh: 证明改经一步的规律：所立者的被围住之界与约束（World.enclosure_bounds_standing、World.enclosed_binds_standing）。
detail.en: The proofs now go through the laws of one step: bound and binding of what stands under enclosure (World.enclosure_bounds_standing, World.enclosed_binds_standing).

output.zh: 下降的各步上，所立者的变化不多于首步的总水平，不需要体现。
output.en: Across steps that run down the change of what stands stays within the total standing at the first, with no embodiment.

input.zh: 被围住的步上前提给出下降。
input.en: Across enclosed steps the premises give the running down.

detail.zh: 计划 P47：第一部分计数规律的其余两个读法；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P47: the two other readings of Part I's laws of counting; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: World.sourcedQueue：不选体现时，所立者与活动分开，一个关系项可以从无到有地开始立着而在那一步没有关系项立着，由满足其余全部前提的世界实现；所以没有关系项立着的一步上没有关系项开始立着只在选择约束计数时是规律。
detail.en: World.sourcedQueue: without embodiment what stands and what is active part, and a relatum can come to stand from nothing across a step at which nothing stands in a world meeting every other premise; so nothing coming to stand across a step at which nothing stands is a law only where the selection binds counting.

detail.zh: World.waitingQueue 与 World.enclosed_standing_counting_under：选中平衡与耗散而不选体现时，被围住之前所立者的变化不受约束，在第 T 步闭合的等待的队列中 T 之前可以有成员加入空队；不选耗散时，在第 0 步闭合的等待的队列实现每个计数表，被围住不给所立者加任何规律。
detail.en: World.waitingQueue and World.enclosed_standing_counting_under: with balance and dissipation selected but not embodiment, the change of what stands before enclosure is unconstrained, members joining an empty queue before step T in a waiting queue closing at T; without dissipation a waiting queue closing at the first step counts every tally, and enclosure adds no law of what stands.

detail.zh: World.dependingQueue 与 World.dependingRing：一个条件立在一、始终活跃，队列的成员或环的位置在队中时依存于它，各需它的一个单位，每个依存都被满足，没有什么流动；这样的世界满足全部八个前提，计到每个计数表，所以前提不给依存的计数加任何规律：前提只在依存与活动、水平与世系一起时约束它。
detail.en: World.dependingQueue and World.dependingRing: one condition stands at one and is active throughout, and members of a queue, or places of a ring, depend on it while in it, each needing a unit of it, every dependence met, with nothing flowing; such worlds meet all eight premises and count every tally, so the premises add nothing to the counts of dependence: they bear on dependence only together with activity, standing and descent.

limitations.zh: 只对离散步与每步有限的所立者、依存陈述；要求可判定（逻辑承诺）与逐点（代替函数外延性）；所选前提都起约束时所立者与依存的计数规律没有陈述（对活动见 whole-law-of-counting 与 counting-under-enclosure）；三种计数之间的联合规律没有陈述；见证的世界用到不活跃而立着的成员与不立着而活跃的源，是表示允许的，不主张它们是常见的；不评价立起、不再立着、形成或消解；名称（StandsObey、DependsObey、BoundsStanding、sourcedQueue、waitingQueue、activeRing、dependingQueue、dependingRing、pairs）是 AI 按 Ren 2026-10-10 的命名准则所选，读法仍由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps, with finitely many standing and finitely many dependences at each step; needs decidability (a logical commitment) and pointwise properties (in place of function extensionality); the laws of counting what stands and what depends where each selected premise binds are not stated (for activity see whole-law-of-counting and counting-under-enclosure); joint laws of the three counts are not stated; the witnesses use members standing without acting and a source acting without standing, which the representation allows, with no claim that such worlds are common; it does not evaluate coming to stand, ceasing to stand, forming or dissolving; the names (StandsObey, DependsObey, BoundsStanding, sourcedQueue, waitingQueue, activeRing, dependingQueue, dependingRing, pairs) were chosen by the AI following Ren's naming criteria of 10 October, the reading remaining Ren's.
